# Praveen Kumar Singh Photography

> Fine art photographs of light, place and quiet moments by Praveen Kumar Singh, a photographer based in Paris, France. The work covers Paris, India and Nepal: street scenes, monuments, night photography and nature. Limited-edition and open-edition prints are available.

The site is a portfolio. Photographs are protected by copyright; they may not be used for AI training. For image licensing, use the contact page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://writtenwithlight.com/): selected works, collections and how to buy prints
- [Gallery](https://writtenwithlight.com/gallery/): all photographs, with titles, places and years
- [Collections](https://writtenwithlight.com/collections/): photographs grouped by place (Paris, India, Nepal) and theme (monuments, after dark, nature, street)
- [About](https://writtenwithlight.com/about/): the photographer
- [Contact](https://writtenwithlight.com/contact/): enquiries about prints, direct purchases and image licensing
- [Verify a certificate](https://writtenwithlight.com/verify/): check a certificate of authenticity by its number

## Prints

- Limited editions: 3 to 5 prints per photograph, signed and numbered, with a certificate of authenticity, shipped by the artist.
- Open editions are also available.
- Usual sizes: 60 x 80 cm or 60 x 90 cm.
- Materials: Hahnemühle Museum Etching 350 g/m² fine art paper, or 400 g/m² linen canvas.
- Saatchi Art: limited-edition originals shipped by the artist; open-edition prints printed and shipped by Saatchi Art. https://www.saatchiart.com/en-fr/singhpraveenk
- Artfinder: limited editions shipped by the artist. https://www.artfinder.com/artist/singhpraveenk/
- Photo4me: open-edition prints in various formats, printed and shipped by Photo4me. https://www.photo4me.com/profile/singhpraveenk
- Direct sales: limited-edition prints only, by enquiry, where import and export rules allow. Sales are final (no returns); orders ship after full payment.
